meta.source: NaijaStaples-30: Makerere AI Lab Cassava, IITA African Crop Datasets, PlantDoc in-situ field images, UCI Rice Disease Dataset
meta.note: Treatments are low-cost first-line guidance for Nigerian smallholder farmers. Always confirm with an agricultural extension officer before major input purchases. Resistant variety codes (e.g. TME 419) are nationally approved NASC/IITA varieties.

diseases.symptoms: Angular water-soaked leaf spots that turn brown; wilting of young shoots from the top down; sticky gum oozing from cut stems; blighting of young leaves.
diseases.treatment: Cut and destroy all infected shoots 30cm below the blight line using a clean machete disinfected with bleach; plant only certified disease-free cuttings from NASC or IITA; use resistant varieties like TMS 30572 or TMS 98/0505; avoid planting in waterlogged fields.
diseases.treatment_ha: Yanke da lalata dukkan rassan da suka kamu, 30cm ƙasa da layin cuta, ta hanyar amfani da matchet mai tsabta da aka tsabtace da ruwan gishiri; shuka rassan da aka tabbatar ba su da cuta daga NASC ko IITA; yi amfani da nau'ikan da ke da juriya kamar TMS 30572; guje wa shuka a cikin filayen da ruwa ya mamaye.
diseases.treatment_yo: Gé ati pa gbogbo awọn ẹka ti o ni arun, 30cm ni isalẹ laini arun, pẹlu machete ti o mọ ti a ti sọ di mimọ pẹlu omi iyọ; gbin nikan awọn gige ti o ni ifọwọsi lati NASC tabi IITA; lo awọn orisirisi sooro bi TMS 30572; yago fun gbingbin ni awọn aaye tutu.
diseases.treatment_ig: Bee wee mebie alaka niile butere ọrịa, 30cm n'okpuru ahịrị ọrịa, site na machete dị ọcha eri na mmiri nnu; kụọ naanị mkpụrụ osisi nke NASC ma ọ bụ IITA kwadoro; jiri ụdị ndị nwere ike igbochi dị ka TMS 30572; zere ịkụ n'ala mmiri na-ebi ebi.
diseases.treatment_pcm: Cut and destroy all infected shoots 30cm below the sick part using clean machete wey you wash with bleach; plant only certified cuttings from NASC or IITA; use resistant variety like TMS 30572; no plant for waterlogged ground.

diseases.symptoms: Yellow or chlorotic streaks and blotches along leaf veins; brown or black corky necrosis inside the edible root even when leaves look normal; severe root rot making the tuber inedible.
diseases.treatment: There is no cure once infected — rogue and burn all infected plants immediately. Plant only certified CBSD-free cuttings from NASC or IITA. Use resistant varieties: NASE 3, NASE 14, Kiroba, or Kaleso. Control whitefly vectors with neem extract spray (50ml neem oil per 10L water + soap emulsifier) weekly.
diseases.treatment_ha: Babu magani idan an kamu — cire da ƙone dukkan tsirrai masu cuta nan take. Shuka kawai rassan da aka tabbatar ba su da CBSD daga NASC ko IITA. Yi amfani da nau'ikan masu juriya: NASE 3, NASE 14, ko Kiroba. Sarrafa ƙwarin farin ƙura da ruwan neem (50ml mai neem a 10L ruwa + sabulu) mako-mako.
diseases.treatment_yo: Ko si arogbo nigba ti o ba ti kolu — yọ ki o si jẹ gbogbo eweko aisan lẹsẹkẹsẹ. Gbin nikan awọn gige ti o ni ifọwọsi CBSD-free lati NASC tabi IITA. Lo awọn orisirisi sooro: NASE 3, NASE 14, tabi Kiroba. Ṣakoso awọn fo funfun pẹlu itanna neem (50ml epo neem ni 10L omi + ose) ni ọsẹ kọọkan.
diseases.treatment_ig: Ọ dịghị ọgwụ ọzọ mgbe ọ butere ọrịa — wepụ wee gba ọkụ osisi niile butere ọrịa ozugbo ozugbo. Kụọ naanị mkpụrụ osisi nke NASC ma ọ bụ IITA kwadoro, nke nweghị CBSD. Jiri ụdị ndị nwere ike igbochi: NASE 3, NASE 14, ma ọ bụ Kiroba. Mechi ụmụ ọchịchọ ọcha na mmiri neem (50ml mmanụ neem na 10L mmiri + ncha) kwa izu.
diseases.treatment_pcm: No cure once e don catch am — remove and burn all infected plant immediately. Plant only certified CBSD-free cuttings from NASC or IITA. Use resistant variety: NASE 3, NASE 14, or Kiroba. Control whitefly with neem spray (50ml neem oil in 10L water plus soap) every week.

diseases.symptoms: Leaf distortion, crinkling, and green mottling; young growing tips become stunted and misshapen; leaves may show chlorotic speckling caused by mite feeding.
diseases.treatment: Apply acaricide (miticide) such as Abamectin (0.5ml/L water) or sulphur-based miticide (2g/L water); spray leaf undersides where mites congregate; remove and destroy severely affected shoots. Improve plant vigour through balanced NPK fertilisation (15:15:15 at planting, top-dress with urea at 8 weeks).
diseases.treatment_ha: Shafa maganin ƙwarin fari (acaricide) kamar Abamectin (0.5ml/L ruwa) ko maganin sulfur (2g/L ruwa); fesa ƙarƙashin ganye inda ƙwari ke tara; cire da lalata rassan da suka lalace sosai. Inganta karfin shuka ta hanyar taki mai daidaito NPK 15:15:15 lokacin shuka, da kari na urea a mako na 8.
diseases.treatment_yo: Fi acaricide bii Abamectin (0.5ml/L omi) tabi miticide sulphur (2g/L omi); fun sokè ewe nibiti awọn ẹjẹ ti pọ; yọ ki o si pa awọn ẹka ti o ni ipa buruju. Ṣe ilọsiwaju agbara eweko nipasẹ ajile NPK 15:15:15 ni akoko dida, ti a fi urea kun ni ọsẹ 8.
diseases.treatment_ig: Tinye ọgwụ ọ̀bọ̀ (acaricide) dị ka Abamectin (0.5ml/L mmiri) ma ọ bụ miticide sọlfọ (2g/L mmiri); fia n'okpuru akwụkwọ ebe ọ̀bọ̀ na-anọkọta; wepụ ma mebie alaka ndị metara ọrịa nke ukwuu. Kwalite ike osisi site na ajile NPK 15:15:15 mgbe a na-akụ, tinye urea n'izu nke 8.
diseases.treatment_pcm: Apply acaricide like Abamectin (0.5ml/L water) or sulphur miticide (2g/L water); spray under the leaf where mites gather; remove and destroy badly affected shoots. Feed the plant well with NPK 15:15:15 fertilizer when planting, add urea at 8 weeks.

diseases.symptoms: Mosaic pattern of yellow and green patches on leaves; leaf distortion, curling, and reduction in leaf size; stunted plant growth; can reduce yield by 20-95% in severe cases.
diseases.treatment: Use resistant/tolerant varieties as the primary control: TME 419, TMS 30572, TMS 96/1632 (available from NASC/IITA, Ibadan). Remove and destroy infected plants early. Control whitefly vectors (Bemisia tabaci) with neem extract spray (50ml/10L water) every 2 weeks. Avoid planting during peak whitefly season (dry season onset). Never use cuttings from infected plants.
diseases.treatment_ha: Yi amfani da nau'ikan masu juriya a matsayin babban maganin: TME 419, TMS 30572, TMS 96/1632 (daga NASC/IITA, Ibadan). Cire da lalata tsirrai masu cuta da wuri. Sarrafa ƙwarin farin ƙura (Bemisia tabaci) da feshin neem (50ml/10L ruwa) kowane makonni 2. Guje wa shuka a lokacin bushewar lokaci. Kada a taɓa amfani da rassan daga tsirrai masu cuta.
diseases.treatment_yo: Lo awọn orisirisi sooro bi ojutu akọkọ: TME 419, TMS 30572, TMS 96/1632 (lati NASC/IITA, Ibadan). Yọ ki o si pa eweko aisan ni kutukutu. Ṣakoso awọn fo funfun (Bemisia tabaci) pẹlu itanna neem (50ml/10L omi) ni gbogbo ọsẹ 2. Yago gbingbin lakoko akoko fo funfun ti o pọ. Maṣe lo awọn gige lati eweko aisan.
diseases.treatment_ig: Jiri ụdị ndị nwere ike igbochi dị ka ihe kachasi mkpa: TME 419, TMS 30572, TMS 96/1632 (si NASC/IITA, Ibadan). Wepụ wee mebie osisi butere ọrịa n'oge ya. Mechi ụmụ ọchịchọ (Bemisia tabaci) na mmiri neem (50ml/10L mmiri) kwa izu abụọ. Zere ịkụ n'oge a na-ahụ ụmụ ọchịchọ ọtụtụ. Abụghị ka ị jiri mkpụrụ osisi si osisi butere ọrịa.
diseases.treatment_pcm: Use resistant variety as your main solution: TME 419, TMS 30572, TMS 96/1632 (from NASC/IITA Ibadan). Remove and destroy infected plant early. Control whitefly (Bemisia tabaci) with neem spray (50ml/10L water) every 2 weeks. No plant during peak whitefly dry season. Never use cutting from sick plant.

diseases.symptoms: No visible disease symptoms. Leaves are dark green, uniform, and well-formed. Plant is growing vigorously.
diseases.treatment: No treatment needed. Maintain good agronomic practice: apply NPK 15:15:15 at planting (200kg/ha), weed at 4 and 8 weeks, and harvest at 10-18 months depending on variety. Store cuttings in shade for planting next season.
diseases.treatment_ha: Babu buƙatar magani. Kula da aikin noma mai kyau: yi amfani da NPK 15:15:15 lokacin shuka (200kg/ha), tsefe a mako 4 da 8, kuma girbi a watanni 10-18 bisa ga nau'in. Ajiye rassan a inuwa don shuka a kaka mai zuwa.
diseases.treatment_yo: Ko si oogun ti o nilo. Ṣetọju iṣẹ-ogbin to dara: fi NPK 15:15:15 ni akoko dida (200kg/ha), pa koriko ni ọsẹ 4 ati 8, ki o si kore ni oṣu 10-18 ti o da lori oriṣi. Pa awọn gige pamọ ni ojiji fun dida akoko to nbọ.
diseases.treatment_ig: Ọ dịghị ọgwụ dị mkpa. Debe ọrụ ubi dị mma: tinye NPK 15:15:15 mgbe a na-akụ (200kg/ha), kpochapụ ahịhịa n'izu 4 na 8, wee haa ihe ubi n'ọnwa 10-18 daa na ụdị osisi. Debe mkpụrụ osisi n'ụzọ oji n'oge iji kụọ n'oge ọzọ.
diseases.treatment_pcm: No treatment needed. Keep good farming practice: apply NPK 15:15:15 when you plant (200kg/ha), remove weed at 4 and 8 weeks, then harvest at 10-18 months depending on variety. Keep cuttings in shade for next season planting.

diseases.symptoms: Small, round to elongated, orange-brown powdery pustules on both leaf surfaces; pustules may turn dark brown to black as they mature; severe infections cause premature leaf death.
diseases.treatment: Plant resistant IITA varieties (SAMMAZ 15, SAMMAZ 29, Oba 98). Apply Mancozeb fungicide (2g/L water) or Propiconazole (1ml/L water) at first sign of pustules. Spray every 7-10 days. Ensure adequate spacing for air flow. Apply balanced nitrogen — excess nitrogen worsens rust.
diseases.treatment_ha: Shuka nau'ikan IITA masu juriya (SAMMAZ 15, SAMMAZ 29, Oba 98). Shafa maganin Mancozeb (2g/L ruwa) ko Propiconazole (1ml/L ruwa) a farkon alamun. Fesa kowane kwana 7-10. Tabbatar da daidaitaccen nisa tsakanin tsirrai. Yi amfani da nitrogen mai daidaito — nitrogen da yawa na ƙara tsananin cutar.
diseases.treatment_yo: Gbin awọn orisirisi IITA sooro (SAMMAZ 15, SAMMAZ 29, Oba 98). Fi Mancozeb (2g/L omi) tabi Propiconazole (1ml/L omi) ni ami akọkọ. Fọn ni gbogbo ọjọ 7-10. Rii daju aaye to peye fun ṣiṣan afẹfẹ. Lo nitrogen ti o dọgbadọgba — nitrogen pupọ buru ipo naa.
diseases.treatment_ig: Kụọ ụdị IITA nwere ike igbochi (SAMMAZ 15, SAMMAZ 29, Oba 98). Tinye ọgwụ Mancozeb (2g/L mmiri) ma ọ bụ Propiconazole (1ml/L mmiri) n'oge mbụ ihe ịrịba ama. Fia kwa ụbọchị 7-10. Hụ na ọnụ ọgụgụ osisi dị nke ọma maka ikuku. Jiri nitrogen nke ọma — nitrogen karị na-eme ka ọrịa sie ike.
diseases.treatment_pcm: Plant resistant IITA variety (SAMMAZ 15, SAMMAZ 29, Oba 98). Apply Mancozeb (2g/L water) or Propiconazole (1ml/L water) at first sign. Spray every 7-10 days. Space plant well for air. Balance your nitrogen — too much nitrogen make rust worse.

diseases.symptoms: Long, elliptical, grey-green to tan lesions (10-15cm) on leaves, typically starting on lower leaves; lesions may coalesce, killing entire leaves; can cause significant yield loss if it reaches upper leaves before tasseling.
diseases.treatment: Plant resistant IITA open-pollinated or hybrid varieties. Apply Mancozeb (2.5g/L) or Tebuconazole (1ml/L) fungicide at first signs of lesions. Crop rotation with non-grass crops for at least one season. Avoid dense planting. Bury or compost crop residues after harvest to reduce spore carryover.
diseases.treatment_ha: Shuka nau'ikan IITA masu juriya. Shafa Mancozeb (2.5g/L) ko Tebuconazole (1ml/L) a farkon alamun. Yi juyawar amfanin gona tare da amfanin da ba ciyawa ba na aƙalla lokaci guda. Guje wa shuka mai yawa. Binne ko kwashe sauran amfanin gona bayan girbi.
diseases.treatment_yo: Gbin awọn orisirisi IITA sooro. Fi Mancozeb (2.5g/L) tabi Tebuconazole (1ml/L) ni ami akọkọ. Iyipada irugbin pẹlu awọn irugbin ti kii ṣe koriko fun o kere ẹsẹ kan. Yago gbingbin ti o pọ. Sin tabi nu egbin irugbin lẹhin ikore.
diseases.treatment_ig: Kụọ ụdị IITA nwere ike igbochi. Tinye Mancozeb (2.5g/L) ma ọ bụ Tebuconazole (1ml/L) n'oge mbụ ihe ịrịba ama. Gbanwee ihe ubi na ihe ubi ndị ọzọ na-abụghị ahịhịa maka ogologo oge otu oge. Zere ịkụ ọtụtụ. Lie ma ọ bụ mee mkpofu ihe ubi ogologo ka oge ọzọ ọ ghara iburu nje ọrịa.
diseases.treatment_pcm: Plant resistant IITA variety. Apply Mancozeb (2.5g/L) or Tebuconazole (1ml/L) at first sign. Rotate crop with non-grass crop for at least one season. No plant too close. Bury or compost crop remains after harvest to reduce disease spread.

diseases.symptoms: Ragged holes and sawdust-like frass in the whorl of young plants; leaves shredded from the centre; caterpillars (green-brown, 3-4cm) with an inverted Y on their head visible in the whorl; severe damage flattens the plant.
diseases.treatment: Scout weekly from emergence. Apply Emamectin Benzoate (0.3ml/L) or Lambda-cyhalothrin (1ml/L) directly into the whorl at first sign of damage. Sand mixed with wood ash poured into the whorl is a low-cost organic option. Biological control: Bt (Bacillus thuringiensis) products applied to whorl. Ensure early planting to avoid peak moth flight season.
diseases.treatment_ha: Duba gonar mako-mako daga farkon girma. Shafa Emamectin Benzoate (0.3ml/L) ko Lambda-cyhalothrin (1ml/L) kai tsaye cikin cibiyar shuka a farkon lalacewa. Yashi cakuda toka itace da aka zuba cikin cibiyar shuka yana da araha. Sarrafa ta halitta: samfuran Bt (Bacillus thuringiensis) da aka shafa a cibiyar. Tabbatar da shuka da wuri don guje wa lokacin tutiya.
diseases.treatment_yo: Ṣàyẹ̀wò ọ̀sẹ̀-ọ̀sẹ̀ lati ibẹrẹ. Fi Emamectin Benzoate (0.3ml/L) tabi Lambda-cyhalothrin (1ml/L) sinu aarin eweko ni ami akọkọ ti ibajẹ. Iyanrin ti a dapọ pẹlu eeru igi ti a dà sinu aarin jẹ aṣayan Organic. Iṣakoso ti ara: awọn ọja Bt ti a lo si aarin. Rii daju dida ni kutukutu lati yago fun akoko fo.
diseases.treatment_ig: Nyochaa ubi kwa izu site na mbido. Tinye Emamectin Benzoate (0.3ml/L) ma ọ bụ Lambda-cyhalothrin (1ml/L) n'ime etiti osisi n'oge mbụ ihe ịrịba ama. Aja agwọkọtara na nzụ osisi tinye n'ime etiti bụ nhọrọ dị ọnụ ala. Njikwa dị n'okike: ngwaahịa Bt (Bacillus thuringiensis) tinye na etiti. Hụ ka a kụọ n'oge izizi ka ọ ghara iru oge ụmụ ijiji.
diseases.treatment_pcm: Check farm every week from when e start growing. Apply Emamectin Benzoate (0.3ml/L) or Lambda-cyhalothrin (1ml/L) inside the whorl at first sign of damage. Sand mix with wood ash poured into whorl is cheap organic option. Biological control: Bt product sprayed in whorl. Plant early to avoid peak moth season.

diseases.symptoms: No visible disease or pest symptoms. Leaves are uniform dark green, upright and well-formed. Plant growing vigorously.
diseases.treatment: No treatment needed. Maintain good practice: apply NPK 15:15:15 (200kg/ha) at planting plus Urea (100kg/ha) as top-dressing at 4 weeks. Weed twice before canopy closure. Scout regularly for armyworm.
diseases.treatment_ha: Babu buƙatar magani. Kula da aikin noma mai kyau: shafa NPK 15:15:15 (200kg/ha) lokacin shuka da Urea (100kg/ha) a matsayin ƙarin taki a mako na 4. Tsefe sau biyu kafin rufe tsakanin tsirrai. Duba akai-akai don ƙwarin armyworm.
diseases.treatment_yo: Ko si oogun ti o nilo. Ṣetọju iṣẹ-ogbin to dara: fi NPK 15:15:15 (200kg/ha) ni akoko dida pẹlu Urea (100kg/ha) bi fertiliser afikun ni ọsẹ 4. Pa koriko lẹmeji ṣaaju ki awọn ewe ba pa ara wọn mọ. Ṣàyẹ̀wò nigbagbogbo fun armyworm.
diseases.treatment_ig: Ọ dịghị ọgwụ dị mkpa. Debe ọrụ ubi dị mma: tinye NPK 15:15:15 (200kg/ha) mgbe a na-akụ na Urea (100kg/ha) dị ka ajile ọzọ n'izu 4. Kpochapụ ahịhịa ugboro abụọ tupu akwụkwọ zuo oke. Nyochaa mgbe niile maka armyworm.
diseases.treatment_pcm: No treatment needed. Keep good farming: apply NPK 15:15:15 (200kg/ha) when you plant plus Urea (100kg/ha) top-dress at 4 weeks. Weed twice before canopy close. Check regularly for armyworm.

diseases.symptoms: Dark brown to black lesions with yellow halos on leaves and stems; lesions coalesce causing leaf blight and defoliation; stem lesions cause die-back; affected tubers show surface rot at harvest.
diseases.treatment: Apply Mancozeb (2g/L) or Carbendazim (1g/L) fungicide every 10-14 days from vine emergence. Remove and destroy heavily infected plant material. Use healthy seed yam from certified NASC sources. Plant resistant varieties: Dioscorea rotundata TDr 89/02665. Maintain proper staking to improve air circulation.
diseases.treatment_ha: Shafa Mancozeb (2g/L) ko Carbendazim (1g/L) kowane kwana 10-14 daga farkon girman dazuwar. Cire da lalata kayan shuka da suka kamu sosai. Yi amfani da iri-yam mai lafiya daga NASC. Shuka nau'ikan masu juriya: TDr 89/02665. Kula da abin tallafi don inganta zagayawar iska.
diseases.treatment_yo: Fi Mancozeb (2g/L) tabi Carbendazim (1g/L) ni gbogbo ọjọ 10-14 lati ibẹrẹ dagba. Yọ ki o si pa ohun ọgbin ti o ni ipa buruju. Lo irugbin yam ti o ni ilera lati NASC. Gbin awọn orisirisi sooro: TDr 89/02665. Ṣe abojuto ifigagbaga to dara lati ṣe ilọsiwaju afẹfẹ.
diseases.treatment_ig: Tinye Mancozeb (2g/L) ma ọ bụ Carbendazim (1g/L) kwa ụbọchị 10-14 site na mbido uto. Wepụ ma mebie ihe osisi ndị metara ọrịa nke ukwuu. Jiri ji ọhụrụ nke NASC kwadoro. Kụọ ụdị nwere ike igbochi: TDr 89/02665. Debe ike ikwu ka ikuku gaa nke ọma.
diseases.treatment_pcm: Apply Mancozeb (2g/L) or Carbendazim (1g/L) every 10-14 days from when vine start grow. Remove and destroy badly infected plant material. Use healthy seed yam from NASC. Plant resistant variety TDr 89/02665. Stake the yam well so air pass through.

diseases.symptoms: Mosaic yellow-green mottling on leaves; leaf distortion and curling; plant stunting; reduced tuber size and quality; young leaves show most severe symptoms.
diseases.treatment: No cure once infected. Remove and destroy infected plants to prevent spread. Use only virus-free certified seed yam from NASC or IITA. Control aphid vectors with neem extract spray (50ml/10L water) or Imidacloprid (0.5ml/L) at fortnightly intervals. Do not save planting material from infected fields.
diseases.treatment_ha: Babu magani idan an kamu. Cire da lalata tsirrai masu cuta don hana yaduwa. Yi amfani da iri-yam mai lafiya da aka tabbatar ba su da ƙwayoyin cuta daga NASC ko IITA. Sarrafa aphids masu ɗaukar cuta da ruwan neem (50ml/10L ruwa) ko Imidacloprid (0.5ml/L) kowane makonni 2. Kada a adana kayan shuka daga filayen masu cuta.
diseases.treatment_yo: Ko si arogbo nigba ti o ba ti kolu. Yọ ki o si pa eweko aisan lati dena itankale. Lo nikan irugbin yam ti a ti fọwọsi lati NASC tabi IITA. Ṣakoso awọn aphids olutẹ pẹlu itanna neem (50ml/10L omi) tabi Imidacloprid (0.5ml/L) ni gbogbo ọsẹ 2. Maṣe fi ipamọ ohun ọgbin lati awọn oko aisan.
diseases.treatment_ig: Ọ dịghị ọgwụ mgbe ọ butere ọrịa. Wepụ ma mebie osisi butere ọrịa ka ọ ghara ịgbasa. Jiri naanị ji ọhụrụ nke NASC ma ọ bụ IITA kwadoro. Mechi aphid ndị na-ebu ọrịa na mmiri neem (50ml/10L mmiri) ma ọ bụ Imidacloprid (0.5ml/L) kwa izu abụọ. Emeghị ka ị debe mkpụrụ osisi si n'ubi butere ọrịa.
diseases.treatment_pcm: No cure once e don catch am. Remove and destroy infected plant to stop spread. Use only certified virus-free seed yam from NASC or IITA. Control aphid vector with neem spray (50ml/10L water) or Imidacloprid (0.5ml/L) every 2 weeks. No save planting material from sick farm.

diseases.symptoms: No visible disease symptoms. Vines are vigorous and dark green. Tubers developing normally underground.
diseases.treatment: No treatment needed. Apply NPK 15:15:15 (400kg/ha) at 4-6 weeks after emergence. Stake vines at 1m height minimum. Weed at 4 and 8 weeks. Harvest at 7-9 months when leaves yellow and die back naturally. Cure harvested tubers in shade for 2 weeks before storage.
diseases.treatment_ha: Babu buƙatar magani. Shafa NPK 15:15:15 (400kg/ha) a mako 4-6 bayan fitowa. Tallafa dazuwar a mita 1 aƙalla. Tsefe a mako 4 da 8. Girbi a watanni 7-9 lokacin da ganye suka yi rawaya da bushe. Kula da iryar da aka girba a inuwa na makonni 2 kafin ajiya.
diseases.treatment_yo: Ko si oogun ti o nilo. Fi NPK 15:15:15 (400kg/ha) ni ọsẹ 4-6 lẹhin mọlẹ. Ṣe atilẹyin vines ni o kere mita 1. Pa koriko ni ọsẹ 4 ati 8. Kore ni oṣu 7-9 nigba ti ewe ba di ofeefee ti o si gbẹ ni ti ara. Sin awọn iṣu ti a ko ni ojiji fun ọsẹ 2 ṣaaju ipamọ.
diseases.treatment_ig: Ọ dịghị ọgwụ dị mkpa. Tinye NPK 15:15:15 (400kg/ha) n'izu 4-6 mgbe ọ si ọpụpụ. Kwere ọgwụgwụ n'ịhịọkụ 1m ma ọ dị obere. Kpochapụ ahịhịa n'izu 4 na 8. Haa ihe ubi n'ọnwa 7-9 mgbe akwụkwọ ọcha ọcha ma kpọọ. Debe ji haaara n'ụzọ oji izu abụọ tupu ị chekwaa ya.
diseases.treatment_pcm: No treatment needed. Apply NPK 15:15:15 (400kg/ha) at 4-6 weeks after it come out. Stake the vine at least 1 meter high. Weed at 4 and 8 weeks. Harvest at 7-9 months when leaf turn yellow and dry naturally. Cure harvested yam in shade for 2 weeks before storage.

diseases.symptoms: Small circular reddish-brown spots with grey centres and dark borders on leaves; spots may coalesce causing large necrotic patches; severe infection causes premature defoliation and reduced yield.
diseases.treatment: Apply Mancozeb (2g/L) or Carbendazim (1g/L) at first sign of spots; repeat every 10-14 days. Use tolerant IITA varieties: IT97K-499-35 or IT90K-277-2. Practice crop rotation. Avoid overhead irrigation. Space plants at 30x75cm to improve air circulation. Remove and burn crop debris at season end.
diseases.treatment_ha: Shafa Mancozeb (2g/L) ko Carbendazim (1g/L) a farkon alamun; sake shafa kowane kwana 10-14. Yi amfani da nau'ikan IITA masu juriya: IT97K-499-35 ko IT90K-277-2. Yi juyawar amfanin gona. Guje wa shayar da ruwa daga sama. Sanya tsirrai tare da 30x75cm. Cire da ƙone sauran amfanin gona a ƙarshen kakar.
diseases.treatment_yo: Fi Mancozeb (2g/L) tabi Carbendazim (1g/L) ni ami akọkọ; tun fi ni gbogbo ọjọ 10-14. Lo awọn orisirisi IITA sooro: IT97K-499-35 tabi IT90K-277-2. Iyipada irugbin. Yago fun fún omi lati oke. Space awọn eweko ni 30x75cm. Yọ ki o si sun egbin irugbin ni opin akoko.
diseases.treatment_ig: Tinye Mancozeb (2g/L) ma ọ bụ Carbendazim (1g/L) n'oge mbụ ihe ịrịba ama; tinyekwa ya ọzọ kwa ụbọchị 10-14. Jiri ụdị IITA nwere ike igbochi: IT97K-499-35 ma ọ bụ IT90K-277-2. Gbanwee ihe ubi. Zere ịgbara mmiri site n'elu. Hie osisi n'oge 30x75cm. Wepụ ma gba ọkụ mkpofu ihe ubi n'ọgwụgwụ oge.
diseases.treatment_pcm: Apply Mancozeb (2g/L) or Carbendazim (1g/L) at first sign; repeat every 10-14 days. Use resistant IITA variety: IT97K-499-35 or IT90K-277-2. Rotate your crop. No water from top. Space plant 30x75cm. Remove and burn crop remain at end of season.

diseases.symptoms: Irregular, water-soaked lesions on leaves that turn brown and papery; lesions often have yellow halos; pods develop dark, sunken spots reducing market value; young infected plants may die.
diseases.treatment: No effective curative spray — prevention is key. Use certified disease-free seed. Copper-based bactericide (Kocide/Champion, 2g/L) may reduce spread. Remove infected plants. Practice crop rotation for 2+ seasons. Avoid working in the field when leaves are wet. Plant resistant IITA varieties: IT89KD-288.
diseases.treatment_ha: Babu feshin da ke aiki - rigakafi shine mafi muhimmanci. Yi amfani da iri mai tsabta da aka tabbatar. Maganin jan karfe (Kocide, 2g/L) na iya rage yaduwa. Cire tsirrai masu cuta. Yi juyawar amfanin gona na kakar 2+. Guje wa aiki a gonar lokacin da ganye suna da raɓa. Shuka nau'ikan IITA masu juriya: IT89KD-288.
diseases.treatment_yo: Ko si itanna afowosilẹ ti o munadoko — idena ni bọtini. Lo irugbin ti a ti sọ di mimọ. Bactericide ti o da lori copper (Kocide, 2g/L) le dinku itankale. Yọ eweko aisan. Iyipada irugbin fun 2+ akoko. Yago fun ṣiṣẹ ni oko nigba ti awọn ewe ba tutu. Gbin awọn orisirisi IITA sooro: IT89KD-288.
diseases.treatment_ig: Ọ dịghị oghere ọgwụ na-arụ ọrụ maka ọrịa a — igbochi bụ ihe kachasi mkpa. Jiri mkpụrụ dị ọcha nke a kwadoro. Ọgwụ ọla kọpa (Kocide, 2g/L) nwere ike ibelata mgbasapụta. Wepụ osisi butere ọrịa. Gbanwee ihe ubi maka oge 2+. Zere ịrụ ọrụ n'ubi mgbe akwụkwọ na-etų. Kụọ ụdị IITA nwere ike igbochi: IT89KD-288.
diseases.treatment_pcm: No effective spray for this disease — prevention is the key. Use clean certified seed. Copper-based spray (Kocide 2g/L) may reduce spread. Remove sick plant. Rotate crop for 2+ seasons. No work in farm when leaf still wet. Plant resistant IITA variety: IT89KD-288.

diseases.symptoms: No visible disease symptoms. Leaves are uniformly green and healthy. Plant is flowering and podding normally.
diseases.treatment: No treatment needed. Apply single superphosphate (SSP 150kg/ha) at planting. Cowpea fixes its own nitrogen so avoid excess N. Weed at 3 and 6 weeks. Spray for pod borer (Lambda-cyhalothrin 1ml/L) at 50% flowering. Harvest pods when they turn yellow-brown but before they shatter.
diseases.treatment_ha: Babu buƙatar magani. Shafa superphosphate (SSP 150kg/ha) lokacin shuka. Ana ɗaukar nitrogen ta asali kuma ba a buƙata yawan N. Tsefe a mako 3 da 6. Fesa don ƙwarin ƙwaro (Lambda-cyhalothrin 1ml/L) a kashi 50% na fure. Girbi ƙwayoyin idan sun yi launin rawaya-ruwan kasa kafin su fashe.
diseases.treatment_yo: Ko si oogun ti o nilo. Fi superphosphate (SSP 150kg/ha) ni akoko dida. Cowpea n'ṣe atunṣe nitrogen tirẹ nitorinaa yago fun N pupọ. Pa koriko ni ọsẹ 3 ati 6. Fọn fun pod borer (Lambda-cyhalothrin 1ml/L) ni 50% ododo. Kore awọn ẹfọ nigba ti wọn ba di ofeefee-brown ṣaaju ki wọn to ya.
diseases.treatment_ig: Ọ dịghị ọgwụ dị mkpa. Tinye superphosphate (SSP 150kg/ha) mgbe a na-akụ. Cowpea na-edozi nitrogen ya onwe ya yabụ zere N karị. Kpochapụ ahịhịa n'izu 3 na 6. Fia maka pod borer (Lambda-cyhalothrin 1ml/L) n'oge 50% ọkụkọ. Haa mkpụrụ mgbe ha ghọọ odo-ọcha ma tupu ha awapụ.
diseases.treatment_pcm: No treatment needed. Apply superphosphate (SSP 150kg/ha) when you plant. Cowpea fix im own nitrogen so no add too much N. Weed at 3 and 6 weeks. Spray for pod borer (Lambda-cyhalothrin 1ml/L) at 50% flowering. Harvest pod when e turn yellow-brown before e burst open.

diseases.symptoms: Water-soaked to yellow lesions starting from leaf margins and tips; lesions enlarge turning pale green then yellow then white-grey as they dry; in severe cases entire leaves die; creamy bacterial exudate visible in early morning on lesions.
diseases.treatment: Use resistant WARDA/AfricaRice varieties: FARO 44 (Sipi), FARO 52, NERICA 1-18. Apply copper-based bactericide (Kocide 2g/L or Champion 2g/L) as foliar spray. Reduce nitrogen application — excess N worsens blight. Avoid flood irrigation in heavily infected fields. Drain fields to reduce humidity.
diseases.treatment_ha: Yi amfani da nau'ikan WARDA/AfricaRice masu juriya: FARO 44, FARO 52, NERICA 1-18. Shafa maganin jan karfe (Kocide 2g/L ko Champion 2g/L) a matsayin feshin ganye. Rage amfanin nitrogen - yawan N na ƙara tsananin blight. Guje wa ban ruwa ta cikin ambaliya a gonakin da suka kamu. Zubar da ruwa don rage ɗanɗano.
diseases.treatment_yo: Lo awọn orisirisi WARDA/AfricaRice sooro: FARO 44, FARO 52, NERICA 1-18. Fi bactericide ti o da lori copper (Kocide 2g/L tabi Champion 2g/L) bi itanna ewe. Dinku lilo nitrogen - N pupọ buru blight. Yago fun irigeson iṣan omi ni awọn oko ti o ni ipa pupọ. Ṣan awọn oko lati dinku ọriniinitutu.
diseases.treatment_ig: Jiri ụdị WARDA/AfricaRice nwere ike igbochi: FARO 44, FARO 52, NERICA 1-18. Tinye ọgwụ ọla kọpa (Kocide 2g/L ma ọ bụ Champion 2g/L) dị ka ọgwụ akwụkwọ. Belata ojiji nitrogen - N karị na-eme ka ọrịa sie ike. Zere ịgbara mmiri n'oghere n'ubi butere ọrịa nke ukwuu. Kwalite mmiri n'ubi iji belata ọriri.
diseases.treatment_pcm: Use resistant WARDA/AfricaRice variety: FARO 44, FARO 52, NERICA 1-18. Apply copper-based bactericide (Kocide 2g/L or Champion 2g/L) as foliar spray. Reduce nitrogen — too much N make blight worse. Avoid flood irrigation in heavily infected field. Drain field to reduce moisture.

diseases.symptoms: Diamond-shaped lesions with grey-white centres and brown-reddish margins on leaves; neck rot — the neck of the panicle turns dark and breaks causing incomplete grain fill (white heads); nodes may also show brown to black lesions.
diseases.treatment: Apply Tricyclazole (0.6g/L) or Isoprothiolane (1.5ml/L) fungicide at early heading stage and repeat 10 days later. Plant resistant AfricaRice/IITA varieties: NERICA 4, FARO 61. Avoid excessive nitrogen. Apply silica-based fertiliser (potassium silicate) to strengthen cell walls. Remove and burn infected crop residues.
diseases.treatment_ha: Shafa Tricyclazole (0.6g/L) ko Isoprothiolane (1.5ml/L) a farkon lokacin kai da sake bayan kwana 10. Shuka nau'ikan AfricaRice/IITA masu juriya: NERICA 4, FARO 61. Guje wa yawan nitrogen. Shafa takin silica (potassium silicate) don ƙarfafa katangar sel. Cire da ƙone sauran amfanin gona masu cuta.
diseases.treatment_yo: Fi Tricyclazole (0.6g/L) tabi Isoprothiolane (1.5ml/L) ni ipele ori kutukutu ki o si tun fi ni ọjọ 10 lẹhinna. Gbin awọn orisirisi AfricaRice/IITA sooro: NERICA 4, FARO 61. Yago fun nitrogen pupọ. Fi ajile silica (potassium silicate) lati le awọn odi sẹẹli. Yọ ki o si sun egbin irugbin aisan.
diseases.treatment_ig: Tinye Tricyclazole (0.6g/L) ma ọ bụ Isoprothiolane (1.5ml/L) n'oge mmalite isi wee tinyekwa ya ọzọ mgbe ụbọchị 10. Kụọ ụdị AfricaRice/IITA nwere ike igbochi: NERICA 4, FARO 61. Zere nitrogen karị. Tinye ajile silica (potassium silicate) ka ọ kwalite mgbidi sel. Wepụ ma gba ọkụ mkpofu ihe ubi butere ọrịa.
diseases.treatment_pcm: Apply Tricyclazole (0.6g/L) or Isoprothiolane (1.5ml/L) at early heading stage and repeat after 10 days. Plant resistant AfricaRice/IITA variety: NERICA 4, FARO 61. No put too much nitrogen. Add silica fertilizer (potassium silicate) to strengthen cell wall. Remove and burn infected crop remain.

diseases.symptoms: Oval to round brown lesions with white-grey centres and brown borders on leaves and grain; seedling blight (damping off) in nurseries; grain discolouration reduces market quality.
diseases.treatment: Treat seed with Carboxin+Thiram (Vitavax 200 at 3g/kg seed) before sowing. Apply Mancozeb (2.5g/L) or Propiconazole (1ml/L) at early tillering and again at early heading. Correct potassium deficiency (apply MOP 60kg/ha). Avoid water stress during crop growth.
diseases.treatment_ha: Yi wa iri magani ta amfani da Carboxin+Thiram (Vitavax 200 a 3g/kg iri) kafin shuka. Shafa Mancozeb (2.5g/L) ko Propiconazole (1ml/L) a farkon tillering da kuma a farkon kai. Gyara karancin potassium (shafa MOP 60kg/ha). Guje wa ƙarancin ruwa a lokacin girma.
diseases.treatment_yo: Tọju irugbin pẹlu Carboxin+Thiram (Vitavax 200 ni 3g/kg irugbin) ṣaaju gbingbin. Fi Mancozeb (2.5g/L) tabi Propiconazole (1ml/L) ni ibẹrẹ tillering ati ni ibẹrẹ ori. Ṣe atunṣe aipe potassium (fi MOP 60kg/ha). Yago fun ipọnju omi lakoko idagbasoke.
diseases.treatment_ig: Gwoo mkpụrụ iri na Carboxin+Thiram (Vitavax 200 na 3g/kg mkpụrụ iri) tupu ịkụ. Tinye Mancozeb (2.5g/L) ma ọ bụ Propiconazole (1ml/L) n'oge mbido tillering na mbido isi. Dozie ntakịrị potassium (tinye MOP 60kg/ha). Zere imere osisi mmiri oge o na-eto.
diseases.treatment_pcm: Treat your seed with Carboxin+Thiram (Vitavax 200 at 3g/kg seed) before planting. Apply Mancozeb (2.5g/L) or Propiconazole (1ml/L) at early tillering and early heading. Fix potassium shortage (add MOP 60kg/ha). No stress the plant with water during growing.

diseases.symptoms: No visible disease symptoms. Leaves are uniform dark green and erect. Tillering and heading proceeding normally.
diseases.treatment: No treatment needed. Apply NPK 15:15:15 (200kg/ha) as basal. Top-dress with Urea (100kg/ha) split at tillering and panicle initiation. Maintain 5-10cm flood for lowland paddy. Scout weekly for blast and brown spot especially around heading.
diseases.treatment_ha: Babu buƙatar magani. Shafa NPK 15:15:15 (200kg/ha) a matsayin taki na farko. Ƙara Urea (100kg/ha) rabin-rabin a tillering da fara kai. Kula da ambaliya na 5-10cm don shinkafar mafuku. Duba mako-mako don blast da brown spot musamman kusan lokacin kai.
diseases.treatment_yo: Ko si oogun ti o nilo. Fi NPK 15:15:15 (200kg/ha) bi ajile akọkọ. Afikun Urea (100kg/ha) idaji ni tillering ati ibẹrẹ ori. Ṣetọju iṣan omi 5-10cm fun iresi isinmi. Ṣàyẹ̀wò ọ̀sẹ̀-ọ̀sẹ̀ fun blast ati brown spot ni pataki nitosi akoko ori.
diseases.treatment_ig: Ọ dịghị ọgwụ dị mkpa. Tinye NPK 15:15:15 (200kg/ha) dị ka ajile mbụ. Tinye Urea (100kg/ha) ọkara-ọkara n'oge tillering na mbido isi. Debe mmiri 5-10cm maka osikapa n'ala. Nyochaa kwa izu maka blast na brown spot karịsịa n'oge isi.
diseases.treatment_pcm: No treatment needed. Apply NPK 15:15:15 (200kg/ha) as base fertilizer. Top-dress Urea (100kg/ha) split at tillering and heading start. Keep 5-10cm water level for lowland rice. Check weekly for blast and brown spot especially near heading time.

diseases.symptoms: Small, dark, water-soaked spots on leaves, stems, and fruit; spots enlarge and turn brown with a yellow halo; fruit spots are raised and scab-like; severe infection causes defoliation and blemished, unmarketable fruit.
diseases.treatment: Apply copper-based bactericide (Kocide or Champion, 2g/L) every 7-10 days. Use certified disease-free transplants. Avoid overhead watering; use drip or furrow irrigation. Remove and destroy affected leaves and fruit. Practice 2-year crop rotation avoiding Solanaceae family crops.
diseases.treatment_ha: Shafa maganin jan karfe (Kocide ko Champion, 2g/L) kowane kwana 7-10. Yi amfani da nau'in da aka tabbatar ba su da cuta. Guje wa shayar da ruwa daga sama; yi amfani da ban ruwa ta layi ko fataccen gona. Cire da lalata ganye da 'ya'ya masu cuta. Yi juyawar amfanin gona na shekara 2 tare da guje wa dangin Solanaceae.
diseases.treatment_yo: Fi bactericide ti o da lori copper (Kocide tabi Champion, 2g/L) ni gbogbo ọjọ 7-10. Lo awọn ọgbin ti o ni ifọwọsi. Yago fun fún omi lati oke; lo drip tabi furrow irrigation. Yọ ki o si pa ewe ati eso ti o ni ipa. Iyipada irugbin ọdun 2 ti o yago fun awọn irugbin ẹbi Solanaceae.
diseases.treatment_ig: Tinye ọgwụ ọla kọpa (Kocide ma ọ bụ Champion, 2g/L) kwa ụbọchị 7-10. Jiri osisi ọhụrụ nke a kwadoro. Zere ịgbara mmiri site n'elu; jiri drip ma ọ bụ furrow irrigation. Wepụ ma mebie akwụkwọ na mkpụrụ butere ọrịa. Gbanwee ihe ubi afọ abụọ ka ọ ghara ụdị Solanaceae.
diseases.treatment_pcm: Apply copper-based spray (Kocide or Champion, 2g/L) every 7-10 days. Use certified healthy transplant. No water from top; use drip or row watering. Remove and destroy affected leaf and fruit. Rotate crop for 2 years and avoid same family as tomato.

diseases.symptoms: Dark brown target-like concentric ring lesions on older lower leaves; lesions have a yellow halo; spots eventually cause leaf yellowing and death; stem lesions girdle young plants (collar rot); fruit shows dry leathery lesions near the stem.
diseases.treatment: Apply Mancozeb (2g/L) or Chlorothalonil (2ml/L) every 7-10 days starting before disease appearance. Remove infected lower leaves. Mulch to prevent soil splash. Stake or trellis plants to improve air circulation. Apply potassium-rich fertiliser (potassium sulphate) to boost immunity. Practice 2-year crop rotation.
diseases.treatment_ha: Shafa Mancozeb (2g/L) ko Chlorothalonil (2ml/L) kowane kwana 7-10 kafin bayyanar cuta. Cire ganyen ƙasa masu cuta. Yi mulching don hana zafin ƙasa. Tallafa tsirrai don inganta zagayawar iska. Shafa takin da ke da potassium (potassium sulphate) don ƙarfafawa. Yi juyawar amfanin gona na shekara 2.
diseases.treatment_yo: Fi Mancozeb (2g/L) tabi Chlorothalonil (2ml/L) ni gbogbo ọjọ 7-10 ṣaaju ifarahan arun. Yọ awọn ewe isalẹ aisan. Fi mulch lati dena fifọ ile. Ṣe atilẹyin tabi trellis awọn eweko. Fi ajile potassium (potassium sulphate) lati mu agbara pọ si. Iyipada irugbin ọdun 2.
diseases.treatment_ig: Tinye Mancozeb (2g/L) ma ọ bụ Chlorothalonil (2ml/L) kwa ụbọchị 7-10 tupu ọrịa pụtara. Wepụ akwụkwọ dị n'ala ndị butere ọrịa. Tee mulch ka mmiri ala ghara atụkpụ. Kwee ma ọ bụ trellis osisi. Tinye ajile potassium (potassium sulphate) iji melite ike. Gbanwee ihe ubi afọ abụọ.
diseases.treatment_pcm: Apply Mancozeb (2g/L) or Chlorothalonil (2ml/L) every 7-10 days before disease appear. Remove sick lower leaves. Put mulch to stop soil splash. Stake or trellis plant for air. Add potassium fertilizer (potassium sulphate) to boost plant strength. Rotate crop for 2 years.

diseases.symptoms: Large, irregular, pale green to brown water-soaked lesions on leaves, often with a white mouldy growth on the underside in humid conditions; stem lesions are dark brown; fruit develops brown, firm, greasy-looking rot starting from the shoulder.
diseases.treatment: Apply Metalaxyl+Mancozeb (Ridomil Gold, 2.5g/L) or Dimethomorph (2g/L) every 7 days in humid/rainy conditions. Remove and burn infected plant material immediately — late blight spreads rapidly. Avoid overhead irrigation. Plant resistant varieties. Apply preventatively before rains begin.
diseases.treatment_ha: Shafa Metalaxyl+Mancozeb (Ridomil Gold, 2.5g/L) ko Dimethomorph (2g/L) kowane kwana 7 a lokutan zafi/ruwa. Cire da ƙone kayan shuka masu cuta nan take — late blight na yaduwa da sauri. Guje wa shayar da ruwa daga sama. Shuka nau'ikan masu juriya. Fesa kafin farkon damina.
diseases.treatment_yo: Fi Metalaxyl+Mancozeb (Ridomil Gold, 2.5g/L) tabi Dimethomorph (2g/L) ni gbogbo ọjọ 7 ni ọriniinitutu/ojo. Yọ ki o si sun ohun ọgbin aisan lẹsẹkẹsẹ — late blight n'tan kaakiri ni kiakia. Yago fun fún omi lati oke. Gbin awọn orisirisi sooro. Fi oogun ṣaaju ojo bẹrẹ.
diseases.treatment_ig: Tinye Metalaxyl+Mancozeb (Ridomil Gold, 2.5g/L) ma ọ bụ Dimethomorph (2g/L) kwa ụbọchị 7 n'oge ọriri/mmiri ozuzo. Wepụ ma gba ọkụ ihe osisi butere ọrịa ozugbo ozugbo — late blight na-agbasapụ ọsọ ọsọ. Zere ịgbara mmiri site n'elu. Kụọ ụdị nwere ike igbochi. Fia tupu mmiri ozuzo amalite.
diseases.treatment_pcm: Apply Metalaxyl+Mancozeb (Ridomil Gold, 2.5g/L) or Dimethomorph (2g/L) every 7 days in humid or rainy period. Remove and burn infected plant material immediately — late blight spread fast. No water from top. Plant resistant variety. Spray before rain season start.

diseases.symptoms: Upward curling and yellowing of leaf margins; small crinkled leaves; plant becomes stunted and bushy; flowers drop without setting fruit; significant yield loss especially in dry season.
diseases.treatment: No cure once infected. Plant resistant or tolerant varieties (look for TYLCV-T or IR designation). Control whitefly (Bemisia tabaci) vector: apply Imidacloprid (0.5ml/L) or Thiamethoxam (0.25g/L) as soil drench at transplanting; repeat foliar spray every 14 days. Use yellow sticky traps in the field. Install insect-proof net houses for seedling nurseries. Remove and destroy infected plants promptly.
diseases.treatment_ha: Babu magani idan an kamu. Shuka nau'ikan masu juriya (nemi TYLCV-T ko IR). Sarrafa ƙwarin farin ƙura (Bemisia tabaci): shafa Imidacloprid (0.5ml/L) ko Thiamethoxam (0.25g/L) a matsayin siyan ƙasa lokacin dasawa; sake feshin ganye kowane kwana 14. Yi amfani da tarkon rawaya a gonar. Gina gidajen sharar ƙwari don nufi.
diseases.treatment_yo: Ko si arogbo nigba ti o ba ti kolu. Gbin awọn orisirisi sooro (wa TYLCV-T tabi IR). Ṣakoso fo funfun (Bemisia tabaci): fi Imidacloprid (0.5ml/L) tabi Thiamethoxam (0.25g/L) bi drench ile ni gbigbe; tun fi foliar spray ni gbogbo ọjọ 14. Lo awọn idẹkùn alawọ ewe ninu oko. Kọ awọn ile nẹtiwọọki fun nọsìrì.
diseases.treatment_ig: Ọ dịghị ọgwụ mgbe ọ butere ọrịa. Kụọ ụdị nwere ike igbochi (chọọ TYLCV-T ma ọ bụ IR). Mechi ụmụ ọchịchọ ọcha (Bemisia tabaci): tinye Imidacloprid (0.5ml/L) ma ọ bụ Thiamethoxam (0.25g/L) dị ka mmiri ala n'oge ịhie; tinyekwa ọzọ kwa ụbọchị 14. Jiri njide ọhọ odo n'ubi. Rụọ ụlọ nẹt maka ahịhịa ọhụrụ.
diseases.treatment_pcm: No cure once e catch am. Plant resistant variety (look for TYLCV-T or IR mark). Control whitefly (Bemisia tabaci): apply Imidacloprid (0.5ml/L) or Thiamethoxam (0.25g/L) as soil drench at transplanting; repeat foliar spray every 14 days. Use yellow sticky trap in farm. Build net house for seedling nursery. Remove sick plant quickly.

diseases.symptoms: Irregular silvery-white blotchy mines (galleries) on leaf surface where larvae feed inside the leaf; heavily mined leaves turn brown and dry; larvae also bore into fruit causing internal rot and making fruit unmarketable.
diseases.treatment: Apply Emamectin Benzoate (0.3ml/L) or Spinosad (0.5ml/L) every 5-7 days — alternate products to prevent resistance. Install pheromone traps for monitoring (1 trap per 1000m2). Use yellow sticky traps. Remove and destroy affected leaves. Biological control: release Macrolophus pygmaeus predatory bugs. Avoid excess nitrogen.
diseases.treatment_ha: Shafa Emamectin Benzoate (0.3ml/L) ko Spinosad (0.5ml/L) kowane kwana 5-7 — juya samfurori don hana juriya. Sanya tarkon pheromone don sauran kallo (tarko 1 ga 1000m2). Yi amfani da tarkon rawaya masu mannewa. Cire da lalata ganyen masu cuta. Sarrafa ta halitta: saki ƙwarin Macrolophus pygmaeus. Guje wa yawan nitrogen.
diseases.treatment_yo: Fi Emamectin Benzoate (0.3ml/L) tabi Spinosad (0.5ml/L) ni gbogbo ọjọ 5-7 — ṣe iyipadà awọn ọja lati ṣe idiwọ resistance. Fi awọn idẹkùn pheromone fun abojuto (idẹkùn 1 fun 1000m2). Lo awọn idẹkùn alawọ ewe. Yọ ki o si pa ewe ti o ni ipa. Iṣakoso ti ara: tu awọn kokoro Macrolophus pygmaeus. Yago fun nitrogen pupọ.
diseases.treatment_ig: Tinye Emamectin Benzoate (0.3ml/L) ma ọ bụ Spinosad (0.5ml/L) kwa ụbọchị 5-7 — gbanwee ngwaahịa ka ọ ghara ike igbochi. Tinye njide pheromone maka nlele (njide 1 maka 1000m2). Jiri njide ọhọ na-acha odo. Wepụ ma mebie akwụkwọ butere ọrịa. Njikwa dị n'okike: hapụ ụmụ ahụhụ Macrolophus pygmaeus. Zere nitrogen karị.
diseases.treatment_pcm: Apply Emamectin Benzoate (0.3ml/L) or Spinosad (0.5ml/L) every 5-7 days — alternate the products to prevent resistance. Set pheromone trap for monitoring (1 trap per 1000m2). Use yellow sticky trap. Remove and destroy affected leaves. Biological control: release Macrolophus predator bug. Avoid too much nitrogen.

diseases.symptoms: No visible disease or pest symptoms. Leaves are dark green, firm, and well-formed. Plant is flowering and setting fruit normally.
diseases.treatment: No treatment needed. Apply NPK 15:15:15 (300kg/ha) at transplanting. Top-dress with CAN or Urea (150kg/ha) at 3 and 6 weeks. Stake when 30cm tall. Scout weekly for whitefly, leaf miner, and early blight. Maintain drip or furrow irrigation to avoid leaf wetness.
diseases.treatment_ha: Babu buƙatar magani. Shafa NPK 15:15:15 (300kg/ha) lokacin dasawa. Ƙara CAN ko Urea (150kg/ha) a mako 3 da 6. Tallafa idan ya kai 30cm. Duba mako-mako don ƙwarin farin ƙura, leaf miner, da early blight. Kula da ban ruwa ta layi don guje wa jikewa ganye.
diseases.treatment_yo: Ko si oogun ti o nilo. Fi NPK 15:15:15 (300kg/ha) ni akoko gbigbe. Afikun CAN tabi Urea (150kg/ha) ni ọsẹ 3 ati 6. Ṣe atilẹyin nigba ti o ba de 30cm. Ṣàyẹ̀wò ọ̀sẹ̀-ọ̀sẹ̀ fun fo funfun, leaf miner, ati early blight. Ṣetọju drip tabi furrow irrigation.
diseases.treatment_ig: Ọ dịghị ọgwụ dị mkpa. Tinye NPK 15:15:15 (300kg/ha) n'oge ịhie. Tinye CAN ma ọ bụ Urea (150kg/ha) n'izu 3 na 6. Kwee mgbe o ruru 30cm. Nyochaa kwa izu maka ụmụ ọchịchọ ọcha, leaf miner, na early blight. Debe drip ma ọ bụ furrow irrigation.
diseases.treatment_pcm: No treatment needed. Apply NPK 15:15:15 (300kg/ha) at transplanting. Add CAN or Urea (150kg/ha) at 3 and 6 weeks. Stake when 30cm tall. Check weekly for whitefly, leaf miner, and early blight. Use drip or row watering to keep leaf dry.

diseases.symptoms: Small, water-soaked lesions on leaves, stems, and fruit that turn dark brown with a yellow halo; leaf spots cause yellowing and defoliation; fruit lesions are raised, scab-like, and reduce market value severely.
diseases.treatment: Apply copper-based bactericide (Kocide or Champion 2g/L) every 7-10 days. Use certified disease-free transplants. Avoid overhead irrigation. Remove and destroy infected plant parts. Practice 2-year crop rotation away from Solanaceae. Plant resistant varieties from NIHORT (Ibadan) seed catalogue.
diseases.treatment_ha: Shafa maganin jan karfe (Kocide ko Champion 2g/L) kowane kwana 7-10. Yi amfani da nau'in da aka tabbatar ba su da cuta. Guje wa shayar da ruwa daga sama. Cire da lalata sassan shuka masu cuta. Yi juyawar amfanin gona shekara 2 daga dangin Solanaceae. Shuka nau'ikan masu juriya daga NIHORT Ibadan.
diseases.treatment_yo: Fi bactericide ti o da lori copper (Kocide tabi Champion 2g/L) ni gbogbo ọjọ 7-10. Lo awọn ọgbin ti o ni ifọwọsi. Yago fun fún omi lati oke. Yọ ki o si pa awọn apakan aisan. Iyipada irugbin ọdun 2 kuro lọdọ Solanaceae. Gbin awọn orisirisi sooro lati NIHORT Ibadan.
diseases.treatment_ig: Tinye ọgwụ ọla kọpa (Kocide ma ọ bụ Champion 2g/L) kwa ụbọchị 7-10. Jiri osisi ọhụrụ nke a kwadoro. Zere ịgbara mmiri site n'elu. Wepụ ma mebie akụkụ osisi butere ọrịa. Gbanwee ihe ubi afọ abụọ site na ụdị Solanaceae. Kụọ ụdị nwere ike igbochi site na NIHORT Ibadan.
diseases.treatment_pcm: Apply copper-based spray (Kocide or Champion 2g/L) every 7-10 days. Use certified healthy transplant. No water from top. Remove and destroy sick plant parts. Rotate crop for 2 years away from tomato family. Plant resistant variety from NIHORT Ibadan.

diseases.symptoms: Leaves curl upward and inward; leaf surface shows mosaic mottling or yellowing; plant is stunted and produces fewer, smaller fruit; new growth is distorted; caused by Pepper leaf curl virus transmitted by thrips and whitefly.
diseases.treatment: No cure once infected — remove and destroy affected plants to prevent spread. Control insect vectors: apply Imidacloprid (0.5ml/L) as soil drench at transplanting. Spray Spinosad (0.5ml/L) for thrips every 7 days. Use insect-proof net houses for raising seedlings. Plant virus-tolerant varieties. Avoid growing pepper near infected Solanaceae crops.
diseases.treatment_ha: Babu magani idan an kamu — cire da lalata tsirrai masu cuta don hana yaduwa. Sarrafa ƙwarin da ke ɗaukar cuta: shafa Imidacloprid (0.5ml/L) a matsayin siyan ƙasa lokacin dasawa. Fesa Spinosad (0.5ml/L) don thrips kowane kwana 7. Yi amfani da gidajen sharar ƙwari don noma tsaba. Shuka nau'ikan masu juriya. Guje wa noman barkono kusa da amfanin Solanaceae masu cuta.
diseases.treatment_yo: Ko si arogbo nigba ti o ba ti kolu — yọ ki o si pa awọn eweko aisan lati ṣe idiwọ itankale. Ṣakoso awọn kokoro olutẹ: fi Imidacloprid (0.5ml/L) bi drench ile ni gbigbe. Fọn Spinosad (0.5ml/L) fun thrips ni gbogbo ọjọ 7. Lo awọn ile nẹtiwọọki fun gbigbe awọn irugbin. Gbin awọn orisirisi sooro. Yago fun gbingbin ata nitosi awọn irugbin Solanaceae aisan.
diseases.treatment_ig: Ọ dịghị ọgwụ mgbe ọ butere ọrịa — wepụ ma mebie osisi butere ọrịa ka ọ ghara ịgbasa. Mechi ụmụ ahụhụ ndị na-ebu ọrịa: tinye Imidacloprid (0.5ml/L) dị ka mmiri ala n'oge ịhie. Fia Spinosad (0.5ml/L) maka thrips kwa ụbọchị 7. Jiri ụlọ nẹt maka ịzụlite ahịhịa. Kụọ ụdị nwere ike igbochi. Zere ịkụ ose n'akụkụ ihe ubi Solanaceae butere ọrịa.
diseases.treatment_pcm: No cure once e catch am — remove and destroy sick plant to stop spread. Control insect vector: apply Imidacloprid (0.5ml/L) as soil drench at transplanting. Spray Spinosad (0.5ml/L) for thrips every 7 days. Use net house to raise seedling. Plant tolerant variety. No grow pepper near sick tomato family crop.

diseases.symptoms: No visible disease or pest symptoms. Leaves are glossy dark green. Plant is growing vigorously and setting fruit normally.
diseases.treatment: No treatment needed. Apply NPK 15:15:15 (250kg/ha) at transplanting. Top-dress with Urea or CAN (100kg/ha) at 4 and 8 weeks. Mulch to conserve moisture. Stake pepper at 40cm height. Scout for thrips and whitefly weekly. Maintain adequate spacing (45x60cm) for air circulation.
diseases.treatment_ha: Babu buƙatar magani. Shafa NPK 15:15:15 (250kg/ha) lokacin dasawa. Ƙara Urea ko CAN (100kg/ha) a mako 4 da 8. Yi mulching don adana ɗanɗano. Tallafa barkono a tsayin 40cm. Duba mako-mako don thrips da ƙwarin farin ƙura. Kula da nisa mai dacewa (45x60cm) don zagayawar iska.
diseases.treatment_yo: Ko si oogun ti o nilo. Fi NPK 15:15:15 (250kg/ha) ni akoko gbigbe. Afikun Urea tabi CAN (100kg/ha) ni ọsẹ 4 ati 8. Fi mulch lati tọju ọriniinitutu. Ṣe atilẹyin ata ni giga 40cm. Ṣàyẹ̀wò ọ̀sẹ̀-ọ̀sẹ̀ fun thrips ati fo funfun. Ṣetọju aaye to peye (45x60cm).
diseases.treatment_ig: Ọ dịghị ọgwụ dị mkpa. Tinye NPK 15:15:15 (250kg/ha) n'oge ịhie. Tinye Urea ma ọ bụ CAN (100kg/ha) n'izu 4 na 8. Tee mulch ka ọriri nọdụ. Kwee ose n'ịhịọkụ 40cm. Nyochaa kwa izu maka thrips na ụmụ ọchịchọ ọcha. Debe ọnụ ọgụgụ (45x60cm) maka ikuku.
diseases.treatment_pcm: No treatment needed. Apply NPK 15:15:15 (250kg/ha) at transplanting. Add Urea or CAN (100kg/ha) at 4 and 8 weeks. Mulch to keep moisture. Stake pepper at 40cm height. Check weekly for thrips and whitefly. Keep proper spacing (45x60cm) for air.

diseases.symptoms: Small reddish-brown oval to elliptical lesions on leaves; lesions enlarge with straw-coloured centres and red-purple borders; salmon-pink spore masses visible in humid conditions; stalk rot and head blight can occur in severe infections reducing grain fill.
diseases.treatment: Apply Propiconazole (1ml/L) or Carbendazim (1g/L) at first sign of lesions; repeat every 14 days. Plant resistant ICRISAT varieties: SAMSORG-17, SAMSORG-40. Practice crop rotation. Remove and destroy infected crop debris after harvest. Plant early to avoid infection during grain filling. Avoid dense planting.
diseases.treatment_ha: Shafa Propiconazole (1ml/L) ko Carbendazim (1g/L) a farkon alamun; sake shafa kowane kwana 14. Shuka nau'ikan ICRISAT masu juriya: SAMSORG-17, SAMSORG-40. Yi juyawar amfanin gona. Cire da lalata sauran amfanin gona bayan girbi. Shuka da wuri don guje wa kamuwa a lokacin cike hatsi. Guje wa shuka mai yawa.
diseases.treatment_yo: Fi Propiconazole (1ml/L) tabi Carbendazim (1g/L) ni ami akọkọ; tun fi ni gbogbo ọjọ 14. Gbin awọn orisirisi ICRISAT sooro: SAMSORG-17, SAMSORG-40. Iyipada irugbin. Yọ ki o si pa egbin irugbin aisan lẹhin ikore. Gbin ni kutukutu. Yago gbingbin ti o pọ.
diseases.treatment_ig: Tinye Propiconazole (1ml/L) ma ọ bụ Carbendazim (1g/L) n'oge mbụ ihe ịrịba ama; tinyekwa ya ọzọ kwa ụbọchị 14. Kụọ ụdị ICRISAT nwere ike igbochi: SAMSORG-17, SAMSORG-40. Gbanwee ihe ubi. Wepụ ma mebie mkpofu ihe ubi butere ọrịa mgbe ọ haaraara. Kụọ n'oge izizi. Zere ịkụ ọtụtụ.
diseases.treatment_pcm: Apply Propiconazole (1ml/L) or Carbendazim (1g/L) at first sign; repeat every 14 days. Plant resistant ICRISAT variety: SAMSORG-17, SAMSORG-40. Rotate crop. Remove and destroy infected crop remain after harvest. Plant early. No plant too close.

diseases.symptoms: No visible disease symptoms. Leaves are uniform medium-green, upright and waxy. Plant growing vigorously and producing heads normally.
diseases.treatment: No treatment needed. Apply NPK 15:15:15 (200kg/ha) at planting. Top-dress with Urea (100kg/ha) at 4 weeks. Weed twice before canopy closure. Scout for striga weed (Striga hermonthica) especially in sandy northern soils — uproot before it flowers. Harvest when 75% of grain has hard black layer.
diseases.treatment_ha: Babu buƙatar magani. Shafa NPK 15:15:15 (200kg/ha) lokacin shuka. Ƙara Urea (100kg/ha) a mako na 4. Tsefe sau biyu kafin rufe tsakanin tsirrai. Duba don ƙwaryar Striga (Striga hermonthica) musamman a ƙasar yashi ta arewa — cire kafin ta yi fure. Girbi lokacin da kashi 75% na hatsin ya yi kwal mai duhu.
diseases.treatment_yo: Ko si oogun ti o nilo. Fi NPK 15:15:15 (200kg/ha) ni akoko dida. Afikun Urea (100kg/ha) ni ọsẹ 4. Pa koriko lẹmeji. Ṣàyẹ̀wò fun Striga (Striga hermonthica) ni pataki ninu awọn ile iyanrin ariwa — fa jade ṣaaju ki o to gbilẹ. Kore nigba ti 75% ti alikama ba ni funfun dudu.
diseases.treatment_ig: Ọ dịghị ọgwụ dị mkpa. Tinye NPK 15:15:15 (200kg/ha) mgbe a na-akụ. Tinye Urea (100kg/ha) n'izu 4. Kpochapụ ahịhịa ugboro abụọ. Nyochaa maka ahịhịa Striga (Striga hermonthica) karịsịa n'ala aja ọcha nke ugwu — sapụọ ya tupu ọ hua ọkụkọ. Haa ihe ubi mgbe 75% nke ọka nwere akwa oji oji.
diseases.treatment_pcm: No treatment needed. Apply NPK 15:15:15 (200kg/ha) when you plant. Add Urea (100kg/ha) at 4 weeks. Weed twice before canopy close. Check for Striga weed especially in sandy northern soil — uproot before e flower. Harvest when 75% of grain get black layer.
